title: Customer prepayments and deposits across the supply chain (foundry, OSAT, equipment, wafers, IDM LTSAs): balances, terms and refund rules 2021-2026
why_it_matters: 2025 filings show prepayments at every tier (TSMC temporary receipts, Amkor advances, ASML down payments, Siltronic prepayments, Microchip LTSA deposits); who funds capacity, and what happens to deposits in a downturn, is not quantified across tiers.
questions: What prepayment/deposit balances do listed foundries, OSATs, tool makers, wafer suppliers and IDMs report each year 2021-2026?
What are refund, offset and forfeiture rules?
Which customers (hyperscalers, fabless) are the payers?
